candidate.original_question: What condition or exception is described in the clause beginning “Provided that the Central Authority may, for every…”?
candidate.original_answer:
Provided that the Central Authority may, for every subsequent contravention, prohibit
             such endorser from making endorsement in respect of any product or service for a period
             which may extend to three years.
candidate.proposed_question: Under the proviso to Section 21(3), what may the Central Authority do for each subsequent contravention by an endorser?
candidate.proposed_answer: It may prohibit the endorser from making endorsements for any product or service for a period that may extend to three years.
candidate.source_text_finding: The proviso on the cited page permits the Central Authority, for every subsequent contravention, to prohibit the endorser from endorsement of a product/service for up to three years.
candidate.quality_or_scope_flags: The proposed text retains 'may' and the maximum period. The reference depends on the immediately preceding Section 21(3); inspect that subsection with the proviso.
